(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  simp only [← Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.not, not_exists, not_and', not_not] at *
  apply Nat.mul_left_cancel Nat.two_pos
  rw [mul_pow_sub_one Fintype.card_ne_zero, ← Fintype.card_set,
    ← Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq hPP]
  intro Q hQ hPQ
  apply hPQ.antisymm
  intro A hA
  apply hPS
  intro U hU
  apply hQ hA
  exact hPQ hU
